about: Balance parameters shared by sim/ and the game. Notes: DOC = from the design doc; ASSUME = filled in for the sim; PROPOSED FIX / DESIGN FIX = deliberate departures. In the risk-3 mechanisms section everything is ASSUME unless noted. Hours use an extended clock: 25 = 01:00 next day. The difficulty ladder values are ASSUME (spec from the coordinator). Semester card names are DOC, their effects ASSUME; 排班表 replaced the earlier 週末打工. These numbers come from the token-era simulation and are a baseline for re-simulation, not validated values (design doc 9.4).

notes.bossSecondsPerHour: [clock] DOC boss fights run 1 game hour in 6 s, so the 5 h caffeine half-life is 30 s (design doc 7.3, 7.4)
notes.liverRate: [liver] DOC the first line turns about 0.6 cups of alcohol into acetaldehyde per game hour, so a cup takes about 1.7 game hours, about 1.5 minutes while exploring (design doc 7.7, from fact 29: 4 to 7 g an hour at 50 to 70 kg); no item, skill, perk or assist changes it
notes.exploreSecondsPerHour: [clock] DOC the chapter clock runs about 1 game hour in 55 s while exploring (design doc 7.2); it stands still while a conversation or a card is open
notes.floorYellowAt: [floors] DOC a floor lights yellow at load 40 and above (design doc 8.4); also where the neglect bonus starts and where the liver's cross-floor clues begin (8.6)
notes.floorOrangeAt: [floors] DOC orange at 60 and above, where the department names an early symptom (8.4); a floor below it overnight cannot reach a strike (omen guarantee); the elevator stops at the liver from here (8.6)
notes.floorRedAt: [floors] DOC red light and strike at 85 and above (8.4); the liver strikes only when 8.6's three conditions also hold
notes.floorOmenCap: [floors] DOC a floor whose load was under floorOrangeAt can rise to 84 at most in one night (8.4)
notes.floorSleepRepair: [floors] DOC sleep repair = 2 x effective sleep hours, for every floor (8.4)
notes.floorNeglect: [floors] DOC neglect bonus +10 for a floor at floorYellowAt or more that was not patrolled today (8.4, 'ignore bonus'); design doc 9.6 lists it for re-simulation
notes.floorPatrolBase: [floors] DOC patrol reduction = 30 + 10 x grade, grade C 0, B 1, A 2, S 3 (8.4)
notes.floorStallBest: [floors] DOC a patrol of a striking floor can lower its load to 70 at best (8.4)
notes.floorStrikeStudyMult: [floors] DOC study efficiency x0.5 while the brain floor strikes (8.4); the other strike effects are not modelled yet
notes.floorContrib: [floors] DOC first-version daily load contributions of design doc 8.4: sleep debt +4 per hour (brain, ASSUME: the debt left after tonight's sleep is used), program deadline +8 (brain, the doc says 8 to 10), caffeine tolerance +8 (brain), late snack +15 (stomach), alcohol +8 per cup (liver) times 1.5 when fasting. All of them wait for re-simulation (design doc 9.6)
notes.overtimeBedDelay: [floors] DOC an overtime patrol pushes bedtime back 1 hour (8.4)
notes.bedOverrun: [floors] ASSUME events and an overtime patrol can push bedtime at most 2 hours past bedMax (the extended clock stops at 29, 05:00)
notes.hospitalFloorLoad: [floors] DOC a hospital stay brings every floor down to 40 (8.11); ASSUME 'down to' means a cap, so a floor already lower stays
notes.hospitalSleep: [floors] ASSUME the night after an emergency visit counts as 9 effective hours of sleep, as in the token-era sim (design doc 8.11 gives no figure)
notes.examPassPercent: [exam] ASSUME an exam percent at or above 60 passes: the base score at the pass threshold (design doc 8.9) with average combat; the design doc names no pass line for the percent
notes.skillNoise: [skill] ASSUME the abstract combat skill k (0 to 1) is blurred by up to +-0.2 per roll before it becomes a patrol grade or an exam performance (design doc 9.5 gives k no distribution)
notes.ratingCuts: [skill] ASSUME blurred skill below the first cut grades C, below the second B, below the third A, otherwise S
